column1: 22521§chew§tʃuː§Rats like to chew on something hard.§老鼠喜欢**咀嚼**硬物。§
22522§speculate§ˈspekjuleɪt§I began to speculate about how she was spending her time.§我开始**猜测**她是如何打发时光的。§
22523§bulge§bʌldʒ§In early May, the northern flank of the mountain bulged, and the summit rose by 500 feet, which indicated that the volcano would erupt.§五月初，火山的北侧山脊**隆起**，最高峰升高了500英尺，这预示着它即将喷发。§
22524§insignificant§ˌɪnsɪgˈnɪfɪkənt§The consequences are insignificant compared to this great idea.§同这种伟大的思想相比，结果并**不重要**。§
22525§revise§rɪˈvaɪz§Teaching methodology should be constantly revised to keep pace with the times.§教师应该不断**调整**教学方法以跟上时代发展的步伐。§改例句：固定说法是 keep pace with the times，删去 the pace 的 the，time 改为 times
22526§deposit§dɪˈpɒzɪt§Overseas students must pay a deposit when they apply for a course at the college.§外国学生如果申请这所大学的课程，需要付一定的**押金**。§
22527§professional§prəˈfeʃənl§Sports psychologists spend time with professional athletes helping them approach competition with a positive mental attitude.§运动心理学家花时间帮助**职业**运动员以一种积极的心态去迎接挑战。§
22528§rigid§ˈrɪdʒɪd§Although glass is comparatively rigid, the atoms are arranged in a random disordered fashion.§虽然玻璃相对较**硬**，但是其分子结构排序杂乱无章。§
22529§solemn§ˈsɒləm§Kit made a solemn vow that he would always stand beside me.§基特**郑重**起誓，说他将永远支持我。§
22530§outsell§ˌaʊtˈsel§This kind of digital camera outsells all others on the market.§这款数码相机在市场上较其他型号**更畅销**。§

22531§forum§ˈfɔːrəm§The huge development in rocket technology is a good thing, but at the same time, rockets cause devastating results in the forum of war.§火箭研制技术的长足进步是件好事，但同时火箭被用于战争**场合**也带来了惨痛的结果。§改译文：原译漏译 forum，补「场合」
22532§anecdote§ˈænɪkdəʊt§In the historical lessons, the teacher quoted many anecdotes to attract students' attention.§在历史课上，老师借用大量的**趣闻轶事**来吸引学生的注意力。§

22533§conversely§ˈkɒnvɜːsli§Conversely, achievements in applied science and technology often provide a direct stimulus to the development of pure science.§**相反**，应用科学技术的成果通常可以直接促进纯科学的发展。§改例句：stimulus 不能和 play 搭配，改为 provide
22534§prefabricate§priːˈfæbrɪˌkeɪt§If implanting subcutaneous blood vessel to superficial fascia, thin transferable axial pattern skin flaps can be prefabricated.§如果将皮下组织血管移位至浅筋膜，可**预制**可转换的薄轴型皮瓣。§
22535§paralysis§pəˈræləsɪs§The doctor injects the patient to paralysis before the medical operation, to lower the pain.§在做手术之前，医生通常会给病人注射**麻醉**剂，来减轻疼痛。§
22536§geometric§ˌdʒiːəˈmetrɪk§He indulged in the study on geometric configuration even though he felt tired of math.§他虽然不喜欢数学，但却对研究**几何**构型充满兴趣。§
22537§floral§ˈflɔːrəl§He devoted much time to floral design in his study room, with the inspiration from a cartoon.§他花费了很多时间对书房进行**花饰**设计，创作灵感源于一幅漫画。§
22538§pollinate§ˈpɒləneɪt§A well-known scientist recently reported that air pollution may prevent bees from finding flowers to pollinate.§一位著名科学家最近提出，空气污染可能会妨碍蜜蜂找到花进行**授粉**。§

22539§objectify§əbˈdʒektɪfaɪ§It is so pervasive a dimension that it is difficult to objectify in spatial terms and difficult to consider apart from oneself.§作为一个虚无缥缈的维度，很难在空间的范畴内使它**具象化**，也很难脱离它进行思考。§
22540§presuppose§ˌpriːsəˈpəʊz§The construction of this project presupposes that flexible money will be available during the following months.§该项目开工的**前提**是在接下来的几个月里要有活动资金。§
22541§recapture§ˌriːˈkæptʃə(r)§Their attempt to recapture the city was foiled by a traitor.§他们**重新夺回**这座城市的企图被一个叛徒毁掉了。§改例句：fail 不能这样用被动，按译文「毁掉」改为 foiled
22542§contrive§kənˈtraɪv§She finds it more difficult to contrive to live as prices are rising every month.§物价每月都在上涨，她觉得越来越难**设法**维持生计了。§改译文：原译漏译 contrive（设法），补「设法」

22543§anticipation§ænˌtɪsɪˈpeɪʃn§According to the anticipation of economists, the global economy will get a burst of growth in the second quarter of 2030.§据经济学家**预测**，全球经济在2030年第二季度将会迎来突破性增长。§改例句：burst 是名词，a burst growth 语法错，补 of
22544§provenance§ˈprɒvənəns§According to the theory of Sigmund Freud, the author of this book searched for some doubtful provenance of jealousy.§根据西格蒙德·弗罗伊德的理论，本书作者寻找产生嫉妒的可能**原因**。§
22545§studious§ˈstjuːdiəs§The belief of "Learning to be Studious" drives him to enter China's most famous university.§“**勤学**苦练”这个信仰一直鞭策着他，直到进入中国最好的大学。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22546§vibrant§ˈvaɪbrənt§Learning memory systems, mental sports and juggling are all wonderful ways to maintain a vibrant, lively mind.§学习记忆系统、脑力运动和杂耍都是保持大脑**活力**的好方法。§
22547§inventive§ɪnˈventɪv§This experiment aims to explore children's imagination and inventive learning skill.§该实验的目的在于开发孩子们的想象力和**创造性**学习技巧。§
22548§protrude§prəˈtruːd§The climber tried to hang on to a piece of rock protruding from the cliff face.§攀岩者设法抓住悬崖外**突出**的岩石。§
22549§managerial§ˌmænəˈdʒɪəriəl§Such systems emphasize the managerial communications function and can be operated easily.§这些系统强调**管理**通信功能，便于操作。§
22550§notoriety§ˌnəʊtəˈraɪəti§Even though you quit, that kind of notoriety will still follow you from one workplace to another.§即使你辞职了，这样的**恶名**还是一样跟着你，从一个岗位到另一个岗位。§
22551§opaque§əʊˈpeɪk§His paper, with opaque cases, made the tutor dizzy.§他论文中**晦涩难懂**的案例让导师感到头晕目眩。§
22552§partial§ˈpɑːʃl§Parents should not be partial to any one of their children.§父母不该对某个孩子**偏心**。§
22553§ape§eɪp§It is pretty well agreed that apes and men come from a common ancestor.§人们普遍认为**类人猿**和人类有共同的祖先。§
22554§portable§ˈpɔːtəbl§A quiver is a portable case for holding arrows.§箭囊是可以**随身携带**的用来装箭的盒子。§
22555§depart§dɪˈpɑːt§Tom departs at sundown to fish.§汤姆黄昏时分**出发**去捕鱼。§改例句：不定式 to 后接动词原形，fishing 改为 fish
22556§gauge§geɪdʒ§These new monitors can gauge the exhaust from a passing vehicle.§这些新的监视器可以**测量**驶过车辆的尾气排放量。§
22557§dialect§ˈdaɪəlekt§The tourists were confused by the unfamiliar dialects in this area.§游客被该地不熟悉的**方言**弄得满头雾水。§
22558§debate§dɪˈbeɪt§There's a debate in the meeting room about next year's budget.§会议室里（大家）就来年的预算产生了**争论**。§
22559§cosmopolitan§ˌkɒzməˈpɒlɪtən§A port will make a city cosmopolitan.§港口会让一座城市**走向世界**。§
22560§helix§ˈhiːlɪks§The DNA molecule is a double helix, resembling a ladder that's been twisted along its height.§DNA分子是双**螺旋**结构，就像是顺其长度螺旋扭转的梯子。§
22561§motion§ˈməʊʃn§For years Newton had been curious about the cause of the orbital motion of the moon and planets.§多年来，牛顿一直对月球和行星轨道**运动**的成因好奇。§
22562§understanding§ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ§The Human Genome Project will open up new understanding of many ailments that afflict humanity.§人类基因工程将开启人们对于困扰人类的很多疾病的全新**认识**。§
22563§circumstance§ˈsɜːkəmstəns§In social circumstances, dress has often been used as a sign of professional role.§在社交**场合**中，服装通常被看作是某种职业角色的标志。§改译文：原译「社交圈」括不出 circumstance（环境，情况），改为「社交场合中」
22564§temper§ˈtempə(r)§It is generally believed that tempers grow shorter in hot, muggy weather.§人们普遍认为在闷热的天气里更容易发**脾气**。§
22565§insurance§ɪnˈʃʊərəns§I'd like to get insurance for the contents of my home.§我想给我家的财物上**保险**。§
22566§impress§ɪmˈpres§Those uniforms for the military were originally intended to impress and even terrify the enemy.§最初设计军装是为了给敌人**留下深刻的印象**，甚至威慑敌人。§
22567§maintain§meɪnˈteɪn§Health promotion programs and policies would help people maintain healthy behaviors and lifestyles.§健康促进计划和方针能够帮助人们**保持**健康的生活习惯和生活方式。§
22568§meaningful§ˈmiːnɪŋfl§Teachers should design meaningful tasks that give students a clear purpose for practising new vocabulary.§教师应设计**有目的的**任务，让学生在练习新词汇时目标明确。§补例句

22569§exist§ɪgˈzɪst§Two American brain researchers studied the brains of human embryos and discovered that the left-right asymmetry exists before birth.§两名美国大脑研究人员研究了人类胚胎的大脑后发现，大脑的左右半球不对称在婴儿出生前就已**存在**。§
22570§jostle§ˈdʒɒsl§In a port city, races, cultures, and ideas, as well as goods from a variety of places, jostle, mix and enrich each other.§在港口城市，种族、文化和理念还有那些来自四面八方的货物，互相**推挤**、混合又互为补充。§
22571§version§ˈvɜːʃn§This scene was cut from the final version of the movie.§那部电影的最终**版本**把这场戏删掉了。§
22572§hostility§hɒˈstɪləti§The hostility of the indigenous population to North American influences is still very strong.§当地人对来自北美的影响仍怀有很深的**敌意**。§
22573§appearance§əˈpɪərəns§His sudden appearance surprised me greatly.§他的突然**出现**让我大吃一惊。§
22574§grind§graɪnd§Tension may cause you to chew too forcefully or grind your teeth when you are sleeping.§紧张可能导致你在睡觉时用力咀嚼或是**磨**牙。§
22575§optimistic§ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk§Psychologists have conducted studies showing that people become more optimistic when the weather is sunny.§心理学家已进行的研究表明，人们在阳光灿烂的日子里会更加**乐观**。§
22576§tense§tens§When pain strikes, we attempt to keep the back as immobile as possible, which makes the muscles tense up.§当疼痛来袭时，我们尽最大努力保持背部不动，这样会使肌肉**紧绷**。§改例句：中文逗号改为英文逗号
22577§ignore§ɪgˈnɔː(r)§If you ignore these instructions, this medicine could affect your heart rhythm.§如果你**不顾**说明服药，这种药可能会影响你的心率。§改译文：原译「没有按」是否定式意译，括不出 ignore（不顾），改为「不顾说明服药」
22578§extract§ˈekstrækt§You will hear an extract from a BBC television program on acid rain.§你将会听到一段来自BBC电视节目的有关酸雨的**片段**。§
22579§therefore§ˈðeəfɔː(r)§The earth is unique, therefore, we have to attain a sustainable balance between population, economic growth and the environment.§我们只有一个地球，**因此**必须保持人口数量、经济发展与环境之间的长久平衡。§
22580§bar§bɑː(r)§Architects in the 18th and 19th centuries began to create buildings by using steel, glass and concrete strengthened steel bars.§18、19世纪的建筑师开始使用钢铁、玻璃和混凝土加固的钢**条**来建造房屋。§
22581§externally§ɪkˈstɜːnəli§The medicine is used externally only.§这种药只能**外用**。§
22582§abound§əˈbaʊnd§The mountain streams abound with fish.§山溪里**有许多**鱼。§
22583§subjective§səbˈdʒektɪv§Taste and smell were subjective senses.§味觉和嗅觉都是**主观**感觉。§
22584§particularly§pəˈtɪkjələli§Mary was particularly fond of bananas.§玛丽**特别**爱吃香蕉。§
22585§quiver§ˈkwɪvə(r)§The moth quivered its wings in front of the fire.§蛾子在火堆前**抖动**着翅膀。§
22586§classification§ˌklæsɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§The classification and analysis of this species occupied scientists for years.§科学家们花费了数年的时间对该物种进行**分类**和分析。§
22587§pollution§pəˈluːʃn§Air pollution is increasingly becoming the focus of government and citizen concern around the globe.§大气**污染**正逐渐成为全球范围内政府和市民所关注的焦点。§
22588§obtain§əbˈteɪn§Today fibre optics are used to obtain a clearer image of smaller objects.§现在，纤维光学被用于**获取**较小物体的更清晰图像。§
22589§mandarin§ˈmændərɪn§Which language would you like to learn? We offer French, Italian, Chinese (Mandarin), Spanish and Portuguese.§您想学习哪种语言？我们提供法语、意大利语、中文（**普通话**）、西班牙语和葡萄牙语的学习。§改例句：中文括号改为英文括号
